lines.trans: Open the door immediately, this is the police!
Tell me, is this your hotel room?
Excuse me, I do not understand you at all.
And what on earth is going on here right now?
Why have I not been informed yet?
I do not understand what they want.
Excuse me, and who are you yourself?
I am the general manager of this hotel.
Then why are you wearing a chef's hat?
Because I am also the head chef.
There is a crisis now, so I have to combine jobs.
And I am also the husband of the hotel owner.

words.gloss: landlady, hostess, mistress of the house

examples.text: Почему я до сих пор не в курсе?
examples.trans: Why have I not been informed yet?

examples.text: А почему вы тогда в колпаке?
examples.trans: Then why are you wearing a chef's hat?

meanings.note: Qualitative adjective formed with the productive suffix '-тельный'/'-ливый'. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('influential').

examples.text: Я здесь очень влиятельный человек.
examples.trans: I am a very influential person here.

examples.text: Пора обозначиться перед влиятельными людьми.
examples.trans: It is time to make our move before influential people.

examples.text: Губернатор встретился с влиятельным политиком.
examples.trans: The governor met with an influential politician.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'man' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Она у нас уже взрослый человек.
examples.trans: She is already a grown adult.

examples.text: Напали вдвоём на одного человека!
examples.trans: You ganged up two against one person!
